subīja.p: [ su + bīja= vaja + a. Vi + jana + kvi. Dhāna, ṭī. 91, 273. Su + bīja-saṃ, prā. ] (na) Google Translate (1) Good seed. (2) Like a good seed. (a) Conduct. (b) Merit.

DOP: bīja n. [ ts ], 1. ( i ) seed, grain; spawn; the stone of a fruit; Abh 950 (~aṃ … aṭṭhismiṃ); D III 199, 29* (na te ~aṃ pavapanti na pi nīyanti naṅgalā); S I 21, 17* (etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni ~āni vuttāni yathā sukhette); 172, 31* (saddho ~aṃ tapo vuṭṭhi; Spk I 250, 28 : kasmā … saddhā va ~an ti vuttā ti ce, °-kiccakaraṇato); 227, 27* (yādisaṃ vapate ~aṃ tādisaṃ harate phalaṃ); A I 223, 22 (kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ ~aṃ taṇhā sineho); 229, 37 (kassako gahapati … kālena ~āni patiṭṭhāpetvā samayena udakaṃ abhineti pi apaneti pi); Sn 209 (saṅkhāya vatthūni pamāya ~aṃ); Pv 1:2 (etaṃ ~aṃ kasī khettaṃ petānaṃ dāyakassa ca); 21:69 (ujjaṅgale yathā khette ~aṃ bahuṃ pi ropitaṃ na vipulaphalaṃ hoti); Th 530 (āsāya kassate khettaṃ ~aṃ āsāya vuppati); Ja I 215, 21 (kedāre pāyetvā karissāma tasmiṃ pāyite ~aṃ vapitvā ~e vutte vatiṃ katvā vatiyā katāya niḍḍāyitvā lāyitvā madditvā ti); IV 42, 14* (sukhette viya ~āni kataṃ tamhi na nassati); V 242, 31* (āmaṃ chindati yo phalaṃ rasaṃ c’ assa na jānāti ~aṃ c’ assa vinassati); Mil 255, 19 (kissa pana mahārāja taṃ yeva ~aṃ kalale rūhati kissa ghanasele na rūhatī ti); 375, 18 foll. (~assa dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī ti); Vism 555, 7* (~ānaṃ abhisaṅkhāro); 583, 20 (bhave sati jāti hoti ~e sati aṅkuro viya); Sp 100, 18 (catunnaṃ phalānaṃ ~ehi dvattiṃsabodhitaruṇe … ārāmesu patiṭṭhāpesuṃ); Pj II 144, 8 foll.; Mhv 15:43 (~amhā tamhā nikkhamma aṅkuro); Saddh 270 (sāsapamattamhā ~ā nigrodhapādapo jāyate); — ifc see kosātakī-, khīṇa- ( sv khiṇoti ), tila-, tumba-, nibbatta- ( sv nibbattati ), nimba- ( sv nimba 2 ), nivatta- ( sv nivattati ), maṇḍūka-; — 2. ( i ) an origin; a source of propagation; an original state; an ore; an egg; Abh 91 (nimittaṃ kāraṇaṃ … ~aṃ); 950; Ja I 294, 1´ (aṇḍaṃ vuccati ~aṃ); Sp 544, 4 (rajataṃ ca jātarūpaṃ ca … sabbena sabbaṃ ~ato paṭṭhāya anāmāsaṃ; Vjb [ Be ] 186, 24 : dhātupāsāṇato paṭṭhāya); 761, 25 (~ehi jātāni °-jātāni, rukkhādīnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); 859, 34 (etaṃ suraṃ vā merayaṃ vā ~ato paṭṭhāya kusaggena pivato pi; Vmv [ Be ] II 42, 9 foll.: yathāvuttānaṃ piṭṭhādīnaṃ majjatthāya bhājane pakkhittakālato paṭṭhāya) ≠ Vv-a 73, 15 ; Ap-a 325, 9 (aṇḍaṃ ~aṃ rakkhamānā kikīsakuṇikā iva); — ifc see tambaloha-, pakkhi- ( sv pakkhi[n] ), suvaṇṇa-; — ( ii ) what is propagated; a seedling, a cutting; a growing plant; Vin IV 35, 14 (~e °-saññī chindati); M I 457, 35 (~ānaṃ taruṇānaṃ udakaṃ alabhantānaṃ); Ja IV 228, 23 (mahābodhito ~aṃ āharitvā Jetavanadvāre ropessāmi bhante ti); Sp 762, 16 (evaṃ ~ato sambhūto bhūtagāmo ~an ti vutto ti veditabbo); Pj II 144, 8 (~an ti pañcavidhaṃ mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phalubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījam eva pañcaman ti); — ifc see agga- ( sv agga 1 ), khandha-, phalu-, mūla-; — ( iii ) a testicle; Abh 273 (~aṃ ca phalam eva ca); 950; Ja I 281, 1 (attānaṃ paṭicca jātānaṃ vānarapotakānaṃ vuddhippattā ime yūthaṃ parihareyyun ti bhayena dantehi ḍasitvā tesaṃ ~āni uppāṭeti); Sp 1016, 5 (yassa upakkamena ~āni apanītāni ayaṃ opakkamikapaṇḍako); 1094, 4 (aṇḍaṃ phāletvā ~āni uddharitvā arogaṃ karissāmī ti); — ifc see uddhaṭa- ( sv uddharati ); — °’- uppāṭana , n. , castration; Ja VI 238, 5´ ; — °- kosa , m. [bīja + kosa 1 ], a seed-vessel (esp. the pericarp of a lotus); Abh 687 (~o tu kaṇṇikā); — °- gāma , m. [bīja + gāma 2 ], the group of seeds; the group of sources of propagation; Sp 763, 18 (tāni hi ~e saṅgahaṃ gacchanti); Sv 81, 23 (sabbaṃ h’ etaṃ rukkhato viyojitaṃ virūhanasamattham eva ~o ti vuccati); Spk III 134, 28 (pañcavidhaṃ bījaṃ ~o nāma); Paṭis-a 690, 10 (~o ti °-samūho); Vin-vn 1002 foll.; — °- nīhāra , m. , taking out, extracting, the seed; ? Nidd I 382, 7 (iminā nakkhattena ~o kattabbo, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se vījanihāro; cf Nidd-a I 416, 9 : ~o ti bījānaṃ vappatthāya bahi nīharaṇaṃ, niharo ti pi pāḷi, Be, Se so; Ce nihāro ti pi; Ee nīhāro ti pi); — °- pūra , m. , the Citron; SAF: Citrus medica L.; Abh 577 (mātuluṅgo ~o); Th-a I 99, 15 (~-phalāni satthu upanesi) = Ap-a 333, 2 ; Thī-a 214, 8 (pupphitaṃ ~-lataṃ viya); — °- bīja , n. , what is propagated from seed or stone; Vin IV 35, 11 (~aṃ nāma pubbaṇṇaṃ aparaṇṇaṃ yāni vā pan’ aññāni pi atthi bīje jāyanti bīje sañjāyanti); D I 5, 31 ; Sp 762, 10 (ambajambūpanasaṭṭhi-ādīni ~ānī ti daṭṭhabbāni); — °- miñja , n. , seed and pith; Ap 396, 21 ( Be, Ce ~am adās’ ahaṃ; Ee bījabījam; Se vījavījam; Ap-a 487, 7 foll.: vibhītakaphalāni phāletvā bījāni miñjāni gahetvā); — abīja , n. and mfn. , 1. ( n. ) not a growing plant; not something that grows; Vin IV 35, 17 (~e bījasaññī); Nidd I 434, 6 (te kammābhisaṅkhāre sosehi … ~aṃ karohi; cf Nidd-a I 435, 11 : maggañāṇena na bījaṃ karohi); — 2. ( mfn. ) not producing growth; not fertile; sterile; Vin I 215, 24 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~aṃ … phalaṃ paribhuñjituṃ; Sp 1093, 14 : ~an ti taruṇaṃ, yassa bījaṃ na aṅkuraṃ janeti); M I 306, 12 (app eva nām’ etaṃ māluvabījaṃ moro vā gileyya … ~aṃ vā pan’ assā ti); Mp II 210, 11 (apūtīnī ti pūtibhāvena ~-ttaṃ appattāni); Mil 146, 20 (arahato … ~aṃ viññāṇaṃ kataṃ); — dubbīja , n. , poor, sterile seed; S V 380, 3 ; — sabīja , mfn. , having the seed (to produce progress); Vism 185, 1 (Vism-mhṭ [ Be ] I 206, 16 : vivaṭṭūpanissayakusalabījena ~o); — subīja , n. , good, productive seed; S V 380, 14 ; Ap 113, 9 (~aṃ ropitaṃ mayā); 250, 17 (~aṃ vāpa ropaya, Be so; Ce vāpi; Se suvījaṃ vāpi; Ee sukhī bījaṃ ca ropaya); — see also udakabījaka, ekabījaka ( sv eka ), bīji(n) ( sv eka ).
